triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER audit_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON ppo.audit_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ppo.immutable_evidence()
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ppo.immutable_evidence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Accepted evidence is append-only' USING ERRCODE='55000'; END $function$
